verdict.rationale: Postman's own CLI can run whole collections, executing many requests in one pass, including in CI/CD pipelines (postman-docs-1, postman-docs-19, postman-docs-32). That is a form of batch execution across many items. However, no evidence documents true bulk operations such as bulk edit, delete, move or update of many requests, collections or other assets at once, whether via the UI, Agent Mode or the Postman API. The Postman API is only described generically as a way to programmatically manage assets (postman-docs-5), which is a building block rather than a bulk feature. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/delete/update of multiple items, bulk actions through Agent Mode or the API, and independent corroboration.
